# Business Guesstimation & Forecasting

Welcome to **Business Guesstimation & Forecasting (BGF)**.

This is an **intuition-first management course** on business forecasting and time series analysis. The emphasis is on understanding **why forecasting methods work, what they tell us, and how they can be applied to real-world business problems**.

The course uses Python as a practical tool for exploring data, visualising patterns, applying forecasting techniques, and interpreting results.

# 📚 Course Overview & Target Audience

This course is designed for learners with a **basic understanding of statistics and Python programming**.

It provides a practical introduction to:

- 📈 **Business Forecasting** — understanding and estimating future outcomes using available information.
- ⏱️ **Time Series Analysis** — understanding how variables behave and evolve over time.
- 🔍 **Forecasting Methods** — applying statistical techniques to real-world business problems.
- 🐍 **Python for Forecasting** — using Python to explore, visualise, analyse, and forecast business data.

This course is **not intended for learners seeking advanced programming or software development concepts**.

For effective learning, students are encouraged to **practice the code examples alongside the material and experiment with the data**.

# 🧭 Course Content

## Introduction to Forecasting

Understand forecasting, forecastability, time series data, regression versus time-series forecasting, and time-series decomposition.

[**Start the course →**](1_intro_forecast.qmd)

## Classical Forecasting Techniques

Learn practical forecasting methods including moving averages, weighted moving averages, exponential smoothing, Holt's method, and Holt-Winters methods.

[**Continue →**](2_classical_forecast_tech.qmd)
